name: Market News Digest
tagline: Summarizes recent news for a ticker and reads the tone of the cycle.
description: Searches the recent news cycle for a company or ticker, groups the coverage into themes, separates confirmed facts from speculation and assesses the overall tone of the reporting, returning a short digest with the sources it consulted.
